summary: Phase 1 (Dreams/Astrology + Apple hide) frontend verification on web and mobile (Expo web preview). All 11 acceptance items PASS. Web: /social has 'Share Dreams' tab right after 'Friends' (social-tab-sharedreams) navigating to /social/dreams; /social/dreams shows dedicated 'Astrology' tab between Dreams and Clubs with astrology-tab, astro-dob, astro-tf-{today,week,month}, astro-generate. AI Readings kinds are only tarot/numerology/compat — horoscope removed. Dream modal footnote (dream-ai-footnote) present with correct '* AI-generated — for fun only...' text; dream-reflect-btn code shows 'Click to know what your dream means' when no cached reflection (verified via code + observed conditional; the sampled dream had a cached reflection so the button was replaced by the reflection block, which is expected). Advisors tab shows large hero (advisors-hero) 'Talk to a verified professional'. Login: GET /api/auth/providers returns {email:true,google:true,apple:false}; Apple button hidden. Mobile: social-tab-sharedreams present after Friends chip and deep-links to /social/dreams; dreams-shortcut-astrology present; advisors-hero present with correct copy; dream detail screen shows AI block, footnote disclaimer text in code and rendered (below fold), and dream-expert-cta full-width filled button 'Talk to an astrologer, sleep expert or pro' as the fallback (opened dream had suggested advisor so 'Talk to Stella' was shown instead — expected). Mobile login hides Apple, keeps Google + Try the demo + email.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile AI-generated footnote Text on dream detail lacks a testID (web has dream-ai-footnote). Not required by the acceptance list but adding testID='dream-ai-footnote' would make future parity tests easier. Ref: /app/mobile/app/social/dreams/[id].tsx:128

action_items: OPTIONAL: add testID='dream-ai-footnote' on mobile /app/mobile/app/social/dreams/[id].tsx:128 Text for parity with web.
critical_code_review_comments: Web dream-reflect-btn only renders when !ref (no cached reflection). For older dreams with cached reflection, the button is hidden by design and the reflection + advisor CTA are shown. Behavior matches spec.

Web dream-expert-cta is a fallback shown only when there is no suggested advisor. When the AI matches an advisor, the code renders dream-suggested-advisor + dream-talk-advisor gradient button instead. Same on mobile. Acceptance tests should be aware of this branching.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded demo dream dm_5cdf5de719544849 and seeded advisor Stella Moon.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web login: email demo@bigfm.dubai / DemoPass123!. Mobile login: [data-testid=demo-login-btn]. Preview URLs: web https://mobile-games-v2.preview.emergentagent.com, mobile Expo https://mobile-games-v2.expo.preview.emergentagent.com. Consent gate (testid consent-check + consent-accept) may appear on first /social/dreams visit — check for it and accept. dream-reflect-btn only appears on a dream that has NO cached reflection (fresh dream); dream-expert-cta only appears when there is NO suggested advisor. To test the reflect+expert-cta branch end-to-end, share a NEW dream first (dreams-share-cta) and open it before it gets an AI match, or open a dream whose auto-match returned no advisor.
